references.text: Instructions regarding the sin offering with a male goat, corresponding to the requirement of one male goat for a sin offering in Leviticus 23:19
Detailed regulations concerning the peace offering (זֶבַח שְׁלָמִים), which is the same type of offering mentioned with the two year-old lambs
A male goat for a sin offering and a peace offering are mentioned together in connection with the sacrificial service
Parallel text about the Feast of Weeks (Shavuot) that includes a sin offering with a male goat, corresponding to the offering in Leviticus 23:19
A male goat as a sin offering for the entire congregation, the same type of offering commanded in the festival regulations
Male goats for sin offerings during the temple dedication under Hezekiah, showing the continued practice of this offering
Male goats for sin offerings at the temple dedication after the exile, demonstrating continuity in this sacrificial practice
